blocks.text: Khoon ka dabao (blood pressure) khoon ki naliyon ki andarooni deewaron par khoon ki dali hui quwwat ka pemana hai. Yeh quwwat khoon ko dil se poore capillary jaal tak behta rakhti hai. Agarche aisa dabao poore vascular nizam mein hota hai, yeh istilah aam taur par systemic arterial blood pressure ke liye hai, jo aorta mein sab se zyada hai aur systemic arteries mein batadreej kam hota hai. Arteries ki deewarein lachakdar hain, aur khoon ka bahao arteries ki ba-qaida dharak paida karta hai, jo nabz (pulse) hai.

Arterial blood pressure cardiac cycle ke marhalon ke saath barhta aur girta hai. Jab ventricles sukarte hain (ventricular systole) to dil khoon ko pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein dhakelta hai aur in arteries mein dabao tezi se barhta hai; ventricular systole ke dauran zyada se zyada dabao systolic pressure hai, mamool ke naujawan balig mein 120 mm Hg. Jab ventricles dheele hote hain (diastole) to arterial dabao girta hai; agle ventricular sukar se pehle arteries mein baqi rehne wala kam se kam dabao diastolic pressure hai, mamool ke naujawan balig mein 75 se 85 mm Hg. Rawaj ke mutabiq readings 120/80 likhi jati hain. Systolic aur diastolic dabao ki haath se pemaish ke liye sphygmomanometer istemal hota hai; is mein pare (mercury) ke column ka uthna aur girna readings dikhata hai.

Dabao ke receptors, baroreceptors, carotid arteries (jo sar aur dimagh ko khoon deti hain) aur aortic arch (aorta ka woh hissa jo charhti aur utarti aorta ke darmiyan murta hai) mein maujood hain. Jab khoon ka dabao girta hai to baroreceptors hissi neurons ko faal karte hain jo dimagh ko maloomat bhejte hain, aur dimagh ka control centre dil ke sukar ki raftar aur quwwat barha kar aur arterioles mein vasoconstriction kar ke jawab deta hai; dono tabdeeliyan dabao ko mamool par laati hain.

Khoon ke dabao ka tawil-muddati intizam hormones se hota hai, jo gurdon mein pani aur namak ki dobara jazb (reabsorption) par asar dal kar khoon ka hajm qaboo karte hain. Jab khoon ka hajm aur dabao girta hai to dimagh ke khaas receptors pyaas paida karte aur posterior pituitary gland ko antidiuretic hormone (ADH) banane par ubharte hain. ADH gurdon ko khoon mein zyada pani rakhne aur peshab mein kam nikalne par ubharta hai, jo khoon ka hajm aur aakhir dabao bahal karta hai; ADH arterioles ko bhi sukarta hai, jo arterial dabao barhata hai. Daen atrium ki deewaron mein endocrine cells hain jo atrial natriuretic hormone (ANH) banate hain: jab barhe hue khoon ke hajm se atrium khinchta hai to yeh ANH banata hai, jo peshab mein namak aur pani ka ikhraj tez karta aur yun khoon ka hajm aur dabao girata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: teen dharkanon par arterial dabao ka graph jo 120 ki dashed systolic lakeer tak uthta aur 80 ke qareeb dashed diastolic lakeer tak girta hai. Daen: mukhtasar-muddati baroreceptor reflex, ADH aur ANH se tawil-muddati hormonal qaboo, aur hypertension par teen box.
blocks.caption: Systolic aur diastolic dabao, aur khoon ka dabao kaise qaboo hota hai (Figure 11.17 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Har ventricular systole arterial dabao ko systolic qeemat tak uthati hai, sehatmand naujawan balig mein 120 mm Hg, aur har diastole use 75 se 85 mm Hg ki diastolic qeemat tak girne deti hai, jo 120/80 likhi aur sphygmomanometer se napi jati hai. Mukhtasar muddat mein carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors dabao girne par dimagh ko batate hain, aur dimagh dharkan ki raftar aur quwwat barhata aur arterioles sukarta hai. Tawil muddat mein hormones khoon ka hajm badalte hain: posterior pituitary ka ADH hajm kam hone par gurdon se pani rakhwata aur arterioles sukarta hai, aur khinche daen atrium ka ANH hajm zyada hone par namak aur pani kharij karwata hai.

blocks.prompt: Garam mausam mein ek shakhs bohat sa mayah kho deta hai. Woh do nizam, tez aur sust, bayan karein jo us ka khoon ka dabao qaim rakhte hain.
blocks.explanation: Tez: dabao ka girna carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors mehsoos karte hain, aur dimagh seconds mein dharkan ki raftar aur quwwat barha kar aur arterioles sukar kar jawab deta hai. Sust: dimagh ke receptors kam hajm darj karte hain, pyaas paida karte aur posterior pituitary se ADH nikalwate hain, jo gurdon se pani rakhwata aur kam peshab nikalwata hai aur arterioles bhi sukarta hai, ghanton mein hajm aur dabao bahal karta hai.

items: Khoon ka dabao naliyon ki deewaron par khoon ki quwwat hai, aorta mein sab se zyada; nabz lachakdar arteries ki dharak hai. Systolic (ventricular systole) 120 mm Hg, diastolic (dheela hona) 75-85 mm Hg, 120/80 likha, sphygmomanometer se napa jata hai.

Mukhtasar-muddati qaboo: carotid arteries aur aortic arch ke baroreceptors, dimagh dil ki raftar aur quwwat barhata aur arterioles sukarta hai. Tawil-muddati qaboo: hajm kam ho to ADH (pani rakho, arterioles sukaro); hajm zyada ho to khinche daen atrium ka ANH (namak aur pani kharij karo).
